description: Compute a cascaded RF link budget. For the chain just designed, call with NO arguments — the server derives stages and input power from the design (after a receiver it returns that receiver's own cascade; a T/R module keeps no stage list, so it is refused). Pass stages only for a bench chain. Returns per-stage output power, cumulative gain, Friis cascaded NF, cascaded OIP3, P1dB headroom warnings and risk; with bandwidthHz also the receiver figures. For a link through the air between two antennas (EIRP, path loss, range), use run_ota_link instead.

bandwidthHz.description: Optional receiver noise bandwidth in Hz; adds the thermal noise floor, MDS, SFDR and instantaneous dynamic range.

claims.description: The user's own figures to CHECK; each gets a row with ours, differenceDb and a verdict. Default tolerance: half the user's last digit.

inputPowerDbm.description: Input power into the first stage, in dBm. Omit for a just-designed chain, or when the user states none (then output power, headroom and risk stay empty).

requiredSnrDb.description: Optional SNR (dB) needed for detection. With bandwidthHz, gives sensitivity = MDS + this SNR.

stages.description: Ordered RF stages for a bench/hypothetical chain. Omit for a just-designed chain. Each stage may declare gainDB or lossDB (loss is treated as -|lossDB|), nfDB, oip3Dbm, p1dbDbm, and an authoritative outputPowerDbm that snap-seeds the cascade. Mark a mixer with mixerRole, plus nfSideband when the user or datasheet says which definition its nfDB uses.

mixerRole.description: true when this stage is a mixer.

nfDB.description: Noise figure in dB. May be omitted for a passive stage given only a loss: the engine then uses its loss, as for a passive part at 290 K, and says so.

nfSideband.description: Definition of a mixer's nfDB: 'ssb' (single-sideband) or 'dsb' (double-sideband). Only when the user or datasheet says which, never guessed; without it a mixer's result warns that the figure is ambiguous.

user_request.description: Required: the end user's own words that prompted this call, verbatim. A figure not in them or in an earlier result is asked of the user (MCP elicitation), or refused.

name: run_link_budget
title: Run a link budget
